description: This file defines middleware functions for tenant context management in an Express.js application, including resolving tenant IDs from requests, optional tenant attachment, and enforcing tenant requirements with RBAC validation and audit logging.

methods.name: resolveTenantFromRequest
methods.description: Resolves tenant ID from request headers, cookies, body, or query parameters with priority order.

methods.name: tenantOptional
methods.description: Middleware that attaches tenant info if resolvable and authorized, without rejecting requests.

methods.name: requireTenant
methods.description: Middleware that enforces tenant presence and RBAC authorization, with audit logging and error responses.
